properties.Desc: The rotation XYZ (roll, pitch, and yaw) of the directional light.

Instead of directly sampling the motion vectors using unadvected UVs, pre-sample the motion vectors and use the advected UVs to sample the motion vectors one more time for the final outputs. This is an expensive option, but it produces even smoother interpolations.
Scales the motion vectors recorded in the motion vector texture. Tweak this value until the interpolation between flipbook frames are as smooth as possible. DefaultValue = 1/24.
Use a motion vector texture to advect flipbook sampling UVs so that the interpolation between frames are smoother.
Specify the light direction relative to the tangent space. This makes it easier to create a specific look with the texture, regardless of which direction the texture is facing in world space.

Compute the light direction from the rotation (roll, pitch, yaw) of a directional light. This makes it easier to match the light direction with a directional light in the level. This is slightly more expensive than computing the light direction using the other methods.

The light direction relative to the tangent space (the direction towards the light, not the direction from the light). Right is +R. Up is -G. Front is +B. The input vector components only need to be in -1 to 1 range.
The world position of the light source. For this input, 100.0 equals 1.0 m.
Set this to True if the motion vector texture is 16-bit (Compression Settings: "HDR") and not in 0-1 range.
Set this to True if the motion vector texture is using SideFX Labs R8G8 Encoding (see Labs Flipbook Textures ROP > Composite > Motion Vector > Motion Vector Encoding).
